checks: Wallet: one-time ₹555, ₹500 cap, idempotent retry and concurrent requests
Reservation: one date rejected, three dates reserved, wallet debited atomically
Delivery: all eight events, assigned courier, pickup/drop-off geofences, GPS cleared after delivery
Feedback: delivery required, ownership enforced, separate food and courier scores
Fixtures: exactly five completed lifecycle records; rerunning creates no duplicates
Languages: English, Hindi and Odia controls; preference persists across navigation
Access: guest/customer blocked from admin reports and screenshot files
Branding: visible Paustik name; versioned browser and install icons
Single meal: one-day lunch without subscription and wallet settlement
Evidence gallery: admin image loads, category filtering and unknown-file rejection
Demo marketplace: 30 profiles, 40 linked orders, idempotent seeding, P&L/CSV reconciliation, mobile and access checks
App UX: customer order-first and empty states, list/grid, profile image persistence, single-order redirection and history pagination
Admin preview: customer, mother and courier simulation with zero server writes and protected role access
Notifications: own-user inbox, opt-in/off and session-bound subscriptions; mocked transport verifies cursor, revocation and expired endpoint removal
Google Maps: validated locations and directions, no automatic map-location requests before a tap
Partner journeys, carousel, role-scoped income, nearby online offers, editable rates, one-winner courier claim and accepted-rate snapshot verified locally.
